brief:
Additive: the control-plane value types and a pure reducer with tests. Nothing consumes it yet (wave 3). No existing file is edited.

STEP 1. iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackIdentity.swift — `LoadID`, `SessionIdentity` exactly as design §2.1 (+ `static func offline() -> SessionIdentity`).
STEP 2. iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/ExecutablePlan.swift — `ExecutablePlan` + `NativeDirectPlan`/`ServerHLSPlan`/`LocalHLSPlan` per §2.2, with `init(_ plan: PlaybackExecutionPlan, request: StreamRequest) throws` total over `PlaybackExecutionPlan` (read PlaybackExecutionPlan.swift and PlayerViewModel.loadBackend PVM:1152-1166 for what each engine needs: loopback → sessionSpec, HLS → url+headers+startMode, native → url+headers; `PlaybackEngineLoadError.missingLoopbackSession` is the only throw). Do not change PlaybackExecutionPlan.
STEP 3. iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackState.swift — PlaybackState, Preparing, Playing, Sub, SuspendedContext, SeekRequest, SeekOrigin, PlayerIntent, PlayerEvent, Effect, EngineEvent, SessionEvent, TransportEvent, TimerID, ReplanIntent (classification, message, operation, qualityPreference, completesQualitySwitch, outputRouteSnapshot, subtitleIndex, position — mirror attemptProtocolV3Replan's parameters PVM:1600 and restartCurrentTranscodeHLS PVM:5180 so both pipelines are ONE intent with a `kind: .serverReplan | .transcodeRestart(TranscodeRestartOrigin)`), SourceRenewal, OutageRideThrough, RecoveryStep, Presentation (stub struct with the fields in §2.6 — fill what inventory-1 §1c lists as actor-changed; it is a value type, no logic). Make everything Equatable (wrap non-Equatable payloads like PreparedPlayback in an identity-keyed box with an Equatable `==` on ids, documented). `LoadRequest`/`LoadOrigin` already exist nested on PlayerViewModel (PVM:839/922) — reference them as `PlayerViewModel.LoadRequest` for now (wave 3 moves them).
STEP 4. iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackReducer.swift — `enum PlaybackReducer { static func reduce(_ state: PlaybackState, intent: PlayerIntent, now: Date) -> (PlaybackState, [Effect]); static func reduce(_ state: PlaybackState, event: PlayerEvent, now: Date) -> (PlaybackState, [Effect]) }` encoding, from inventory-1 §2/§4/§6:
 - `.load(request, origin)` from any state: mint LoadID; effects in the order beginFreshLoad does them (cancel timers for the previous load, `.stopSession(prevIdentity, …)`+`.reportProgress` if a session existed and finalizeCurrentSession, `.disposeEngine(prevLoadID)` unless the origin reuses the engine, `.startSession(request, loadID)`) → `.preparing(.resolvingSession)`.
 - `.session(.prepared(p), identity)` while preparing with matching LoadID → `.planning` → `.loadEngine(plan, loadID, reuseEngine:false)` → `.startingEngine`; stale LoadID ⇒ ignored (no effects).
 - `.engine(.fileLoaded, loadID)` → `.playing(.steady)` + `.reportPlanExecutionStarted` per origin rule (fresh + V3 replan report; transcode restart does NOT — PVM:2700-2715) + `.publish`.
 - `.engine(.failed(f), loadID)` while playing → `.recovery` is NOT decided here: emit `.runRecovery`? NO — the reducer consumes `PlayerEvent.recovery(action, loadID)` (produced by the actor after RecoveryPolicy.decide): map RecoveryAction → Sub + Effects: `.requestServerReplan` → `.replanning(intent)` + `.replan(intent, identity)`; `.renewSourceInBackground` → `.renewingSource` + `.renewSource`; `.renewSessionFresh` → a new `.load(request.copyForRecovery, .recovery)`; `.rideThroughOutage` → `.ridingOutOutage` + `.pollServerHealth`; `.endOutageRideThrough` → `.steady` + `.runRecovery(.endOutageRideThrough)`; `.recoverFromServerOutage` → `.disposeEngine` + `.pollServerHealth` + `.publish(reconnecting)`; `.waitForServerReady` → `.pollServerHealth`; `.treatAsNaturalEnd` → `.ended`; `.switchRoute` → new load of the fallback plan with reuse false; `.fail(f)` → `.failed(f, loadID)` + `.stopSession` + `.publish(error)`; loopback in-route actions → `.runRecovery(action, loadID)` with `.recovering(step)` only for multi-step ones (rebuild/reload) and `.steady` otherwise.
 - `.replan` while `.replanning` ⇒ reducer returns state unchanged + no effects (§11 #22) — pin it; while `.renewingSource` the same.
 - `.session(.replanned(p), identity)` while replanning with matching identity → `.loadEngine(plan, loadID, reuseEngine: intent.kind == .serverReplan && plan.engine == current.engine)` (PlaybackAdoptionOrigin.reusesActiveEngine PVM:2484) → `.startingEngine` keeping the same LoadID? NO: a new LoadID is minted for every loadEngine (callbacks re-bound) — the engine instance is reused, the LoadID is not (review #1). `.replanUnavailable`/`.terminal` → `.failed`; `.sessionMissing` → recovery event path.
 - `.seek(target, origin)` → `SeekRequest(id, target, origin, deadline: now + 15 s)` → `.seeking(req)` + `.seek(req, loadID)`; a new LoadID drops it structurally; `.engine(.time)` clears `.seeking` when the filter rule (PVM:1244-1255 seekOriginTime/seekTargetTime) is satisfied — port that rule; `.timer(.seekFilterTimeout)` clears it.
 - `.scenePhase(phase)` → the three platform tables from inventory-1 §6 as data (`#if os` inside the reducer is acceptable in wave 1; the outcomes must equal today's: tvOS inactive→interruption pause, background→`.suspended(ctx)` + `.disposeEngine` + `.stopSession` (suspendStopSessionTask), active→if suspended nothing else interruption recovery timer; macOS background→`.pause` effect; iOS background→AirPlay/PiP exemptions → pause unless exempt; active → cancel PiP grace).
 - `.resumeSuspended` → `.load(ctx.request, …, resumePosition)`; `.retry`; `.dismiss` → `.disposed` + cancel all + stop session.
 - `.play/.pause/.togglePlayPause` → `.publish` + an `Effect.transport(.play/.pause, loadID)` (add this Effect case; note it in notes).
 Keep the reducer free of Date() (now is a parameter) and of any I/O.
STEP 5. iosApp/Tests/PlaybackReducerTests.swift (≥ 15): fresh load effect order; stale prepared event ignored; fileLoaded → playing + report rule per origin; replan while replanning rejected; replanned with same engine → reuseEngine true and a NEW LoadID; seek request dropped by new load; seek filter/timeout; ended sub-state; fail → failed + stopSession; suspend/resume round trip (tvOS table); scene-phase tables for iOS/macOS/tvOS; outage ride-through → pollServerHealth; exactly one effect set per recovery action. Use a fixed `now`.

HARD BOUNDARIES: new files only; no wiring; do not edit PlayerViewModel/Bridge/Backend; no protocols; Equatable everywhere.

deliverables.id: PlaybackState family (State, Sub, SeekRequest/Origin, PlayerIntent, PlayerEvent, Effect, EngineEvent, SessionEvent, TransportEvent, TimerID, ReplanIntent, Presentation)

invariants: Effect ORDER for a fresh load equals beginFreshLoad/freshLoadTask/adoptPreparedPlayback/loadStream order (inventory-1 §2)
reuseEngine is true exactly when PlaybackAdoptionOrigin.reusesActiveEngine is true today (V3 server replan, same engine) and every loadEngine mints a new LoadID
Second replan while replanning produces no effects
Scene-phase outcomes per platform equal inventory-1 §6
Reducer is pure (no Date(), no I/O); all types Equatable
No existing file changes; suite total = 1539 + tests added
